verdict.rationale: Token2's official open-source fido2-manage (libfido2-based) provides command-line tools for FIDO2 keys. It covers setting and changing PINs and minimum PIN length, passkey list/delete/edit, biometric enrollment and SSH resident keys. It also dumps device info and relying parties to JSON/CSV, which makes reading device state scriptable. However, PIV configuration is handled through the Windows miniDriver or the GUI Companion App rather than a documented CLI, and there is no evidence of CLI commands to enable or disable applications/interfaces or to manage PIV/OTP slots. Missing for 10: CLI to enable/disable applications, CLI management of PIV/OTP slots, independent hands-on corroboration of scripted use.
